title: Whale's Dream Portal
description: A surreal fantasy scene framed within an ornate steampunk monitor-like border with glowing buttons and roots at the base. A large white whale with purple eyes and flowers on its back floats in a dreamlike blue-purple space, carrying a spiral tower of books and musical notation that swirls upward into the sky.
prompt: A large white whale with purple markings and flowers growing on its back floats in a dreamy purple and blue ethereal space, carrying a multi-tiered tower on its back with books, candles, and a swirling spiral of musical notation rising into the sky. The entire scene is contained within an ornate dark metallic steampunk monitor frame with glowing buttons and roots extending from the bottom. Purple flowers and butterflies surround the base, soft glowing particles in the air, whimsical and magical atmosphere.
